thread.title: DJIA Posted a New Record High, S&P 500 Flat, NAS Underpreforms

author: Paul Ebeling
title: DJIA Posted a New Record High, S&P 500 Flat, NAS Underpreforms
text:
DJIA Posted a New Record High, S&P 500 Flat, NAS Underpreforms 
$DIA, $SPY, $QQQ, $VXX 
Wednesday, the DJIA marked to a new all-time high, but NAS Comp retreated from records on weakness in Apple ( NASDAQ :AAPL) shares. 

US stocks have rallied in recent weeks as enthusiasm about US tax cuts adds to optimism at improving US and global economic data. 
This Trump Rally is a spectacular run with 397 days without a 3-5% pullback, but do not surprised if we have some profit taking at some point given how strong the rally has been, it would be a healthy event. 
Weakness in Apple weighed down the Nasdaq , with the world’s biggest company by market capitalization falling 1.6% on negative speculation about iPhone sales in the current Quarter. 
Wednesday, the major US stock market indexes finished at: DJIA +41.31 at 26252.12, NAS Comp -45.23 at 7415.05, S&P 500 -1.59 at 2837.54 
Volume: Trade on the NYSE came in at: 950-M/shares exchanged. NAS Comp: +7.4% YTD S&P 500: +6.1% YTD Russell 2000: +4.2% YTD
